svg.title: Figure 3-3: internal block diagram of the Gate A unit
svg.desc: A SysML internal block diagram: the command chain operator, compute, low-level controller, motor drivers and chassis along the top; LiDAR, camera, IMU and encoders below their consumers; power at the bottom; port squares on every part and item flows labelled with the interface IDs; the driver fault, speed and brake pins drawn grey dashed as unwired and the E-stop button red dashed as undocumented.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 3-3 Internal block diagram (SysML ibd): parts, ports and item flows

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Connectors carry the §3.3 interface IDs (full content in the table). Grey dashed: driver pins that exist and are not wired. Red dashed: the E-stop button, which switches nothing documented.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
